anti_overlap: fd-pressure-emission-contract covers LegitimacyCrisis burst write triggered by large gap values
decision_lens: A gap that initializes to 0.0 for all countries is P1 (eliminates archetype starting conditions). A gap that exceeds ±0.5 corrupts the ShadowBench scoring surface — P0.
focus: Correctness of the performed_trust / actual_trust split, convergence rate derivation from regime blend, and gap range enforcement
name: fd-hypernormal-gap-dynamics
persona: A control-systems engineer who models lag dynamics in feedback systems. Looks for initialization states that skip lag, convergence rates that are too fast, and range violations in the [-0.5, 0.5] gap.
review_areas: performed_trust initialization: verify archetype seed carries performed_trust_baseline and init_countries sets it independently from institutional_trust
Convergence rate blend: must be weighted sum of per-regime coefficients dotted against epistemic_regime_blend each tick, not cached at seed time
Gap range clamp: explicit clamp to [-0.5, 0.5] after subtraction
Regime-dependent convergence: NETWORKED countries collapse gap quickly, verify measurable reduction in 10-20 ticks
Enforcement capacity interaction: D3 enforcement_capacity should sustain performed_trust even when actual_trust falls
Trigger event burst: +0.10 LegitimacyCrisis burst when gap > 0.3 AND trigger event — verify status

severity_examples.condition: Occurs if init_countries uses wrong seed field
severity_examples.scenario: performed_trust initialized from institutional_trust_baseline instead of performed_trust_baseline, so hypernormal_gap starts at 0.0 for all countries including Rentier states

severity_examples.condition: Occurs if implementer caches convergence_rate in PublicOpinionCountrySeed
severity_examples.scenario: convergence_rate computed once at seed time and cached, never updating when regime shifts

success_hints: After 30 ticks with no shocks, SAU/RUS hypernormal_gap > 0.1; USA/DEU hypernormal_gap < 0.05
A country with networked_weight 0.6 converges gap roughly 4x faster than broadcast-dominant
hypernormal_gap strictly within [-0.5, 0.5] for all countries under all pressure combinations
task_context: The implementation separates hypernormal_gap into performed_trust and actual_trust channels. Convergence rate is a weighted dot product of regime blend with per-regime coefficients.
